svg.text: Deep-learning height estimator · 12.7 s per 625 × 625 m scene on a laptop GPU
• RMSE 4.69 m (ours) vs 6.74 m (RS3DAda), same tiles: 30 % lower
Interactive 3D fly-through (Three.js, runs in a browser)
• probe · measure · height profile · model vs LiDAR truth · error map
• upload PNG / JPG / GeoTIFF and run the model live

All accuracy figures are measured against airborne LiDAR on 40 held-out GAMUS test tiles (headline 4.69 m: 1,500-tile model; per-landscape and resolution: 480-tile model). Imagery: Maxar Open Data (CC BY-NC 4.0). Terrain: Copernicus DEM GLO-30.
